featured_reviews.review_text: So we had received  cash/gift voucher for Rs 1200/-. Went and purchased a few products here and the Bill turned up to be Rs 1800/-. featured_reviews.review_text:
They sell poor quality goods and on top of it the customer service is also pathetic.
I had bought an umbrella and it broke the 1st time i used it. When i went to complaint they said this umbrella is not to be used in heavy rains and it was only for light rains. I said no one in Mumbai will carry 2 umbrellas, 1 for heavy and 1 for light rains. The worst is about to come.
They took it for repairs and said il get a call but 20 days lapsed and i didn't get a call. On enquiry they told me i can come and chose another umbrella as mine couldn't even get repaired.
I go to the store and the employee shows me different umbrellas. In front of me he told all customers there was a sale on all umbrellas and after deducting money i had to pay a little extra. I refused to pay so they took me to the guy at the counter.
Now, THAT GUY REFUSED TO ACKNOWLEDGE ANY DISCOUNT ON THOSE UMBRELLAS EVEN AFTER BEING REMINDED BY THE EMPLOYEE. CLEARLY HE WAS GREEDY AND THOUGHT IL PAY MORE MONEY.
And then again started his blabbering that this was a light rain umbrella and that everyone in Mumbai carries 2 umbrellas😂.
After arguing a lot, he finally agreed to let me buy something else in exchange.
Moral of the story: Never buy from this store. You never know how you will be treated!
